names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Αγάθωνας ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off. The day's line spells the nominative «Αγάθωνας»; the life page heads him «Αγιος Αγαθωνας» and the body of it writes «Ο Άγιος Αγάθων», which is the form taken here.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Αγάθωνας ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The whole of his page is one sentence: he was a presbyter and was martyred with other Christians at Alexandria. It gives no year, no emperor, no names for the others and no hymn.
